title: Solid Axle Suspension - Air Spring
text: 空气弹簧整体桥悬架，输入 10 路、输出 6 路；按 {Roll steer vs suspension height slope, RollStrgSlp} 指定转向角悬架斜率；{Model type} 指定空气悬架模型类型、{Number of axles, NumAxl} 指定车轴数、{Number of wheels by axle, NumWhlsByAxl} 指定每个车轴的车轮数、{Steered axle enable by axle, StrgEnByAxl} 用于启用车轴转向的布尔向量、{Axle and wheels lumped principal moment of inertia about longitudinal axis, AxlIxx} 指定绕纵轴的主惯性矩、{Axle and wheels lumped mass, AxlM} 指定车轴和车轮的集中质量、{Track hardpoint coordinates relative to axle center, TrackCoords} 指定轮距硬点坐标、{Suspension hardpoint coordinates relative to axle center, SuspCoords} 指定悬架硬点坐标、{Wheel and axle interface compliance constant, KzWhlAxl} 指定车轮与车轴接口柔度常数、{Wheel and axle interface compliance preload, F0zWhlAxl} 指定车轮与车轴接口柔度预载荷、{Wheel and axle interface damping constant, CzWhlAxl [Ns/m]} 指定车轮与车轴接口阻尼常数、{Air suspension spring preload, F0z} 指定空气悬架弹簧预载荷、{Air suspension shock damping constant, Cz} 指定空气悬架减震器阻尼常数、{Air spring effective area, EffctArea} 指定空气弹簧有效面积、{Air spring volume in design position, VolDgnPos} 指定设计位置处的空气弹簧体积、{Air spring isentropic exponent, IstpExp} 指定空气弹簧等熵指数、{Air spring outer diameter, OuterDiam} 指定空气弹簧外径、{Air spring piston diameter, PistDiam} 指定空气弹簧活塞直径、{Air suspension maximum height, Hmax} 指定空气悬架最大高度、{Toe angle at steering center, Toe} 指定前束角、{Toe angle vs steering angle slope, ToeStrgSlp} 指定前束角转向斜率、{Caster angle at steering center, Caster} 指定转向中心处的后倾角、{Caster angle vs suspension height slope, CasterHslp} 指定后倾角相对于悬架高度的斜率、{Caster angle vs steering angle slope, CasterStrgSlp} 指定后倾角相对于转向角的斜率、{Camber angle at steering center, Camber} 指定转向中心处的外倾角、{Camber angle vs suspension height slope, CamberHslp} 指定外倾角相对于悬架高度的斜率、{Camber angle vs steering angle slope, CamberStrgSlp} 指定外倾角相对于转向角的斜率、{Suspension height vs steering angle slope, StrgHgtSlp} 指定悬架高度相对于转向角的斜率、{Axle breakpoints, f_susp_axl_bp} 指定断点、{Vertical axis suspension height breakpoints, f_susp_dz_bp} 指定断点 1 -by、{Vertical axis air suspension pressure breakpoints, f_susp_press_bp} 指定垂直轴空气悬架压力断点、{Vertical air axis suspension force and moment responses, f_susp_fmz} 输出数组 zeros、{Air suspension shock damping constant, c_airSusp} 指定空气悬架减震器阻尼常数 6e6、{Suspension geometry responses, f_susp_geom} 指定悬架几何响应 zeros、{Steering angle breakpoints, f_susp_strgdelta_bp} 指定转向角度断点 1 -by，按实例取值。
